newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR WEDS.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR WEDS.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Wednesday it had set a tender for a seven-day securities reverse repurchase for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering to drain an unspecified volume of market liquidity.
The NBS said in a statement that the American-style tender would have no fixed minimum rate.
"Despite an apparent shortage at the present, the banking sector is in a liquidity surplus according to our prediction," Peter Andresic, head of the Open Market Operation Department, told Reuters.
Andresic added that a 600 million crown reverse repo pact expires today.
According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 95.65 percent as of Tuesday, after 94.2 percent the previous day.
